statements.query: select "users"."id", "users"."name", "users"."email", "users"."created_at", "users_posts"."data" as "posts" from "users" "users" left join lateral (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_array("users_posts"."id", "users_posts"."title", "users_posts"."body", "users_posts"."created_at", "users_posts_comments"."data") order by "users_posts"."id" asc), $3::json) as "data" from (select * from "posts" "users_posts" where "users_posts"."user_id" = "users"."id" order by "users_posts"."id" asc) "users_posts" left join lateral (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_array("users_posts_comments"."id", "users_posts_comments"."author", "users_posts_comments"."body", "users_posts_comments"."created_at") order by "users_posts_comments"."id" asc), $4::json) as "data" from (select * from "comments" "users_posts_comments" where "users_posts_comments"."post_id" = "users_posts"."id" order by "users_posts_comments"."id" asc) "users_posts_comments") "users_posts_comments" on $5) "users_posts" on $6 where "users"."id" = $1 limit $2
